context: Request: which Bankruptcy & Restructuring matters produced a confirmed plan of reorganization that the firm drafted. Rubric: 1006-00002 (Crestline Packaging, Chapter 11 plan confirmed) as the qualifying matter, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists every matter folder with file counts; the output is cut.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Attempt 2: Saves the folder list to a file and counts 266 folders and 9,288 files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: One find \| grep over all paths with broad request words; 444 hits, per-matter counts cut. The review flags noise and no text search.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out twice; falls back to per-word file-name counts.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: Range scans run in the background write per-matter hit files; greps of the saved output for exact phrases (with line caps) and per-file hits for six matters. The review flags the caps and the hand-picked six.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: new: Consolidate full candidate pool from scan files. A heredoc error, then a per-matter table of the saved scan output (250 matters, output cut); no new store reads. The review flags that most of the table was never seen.
stages.agent_new: Consolidate full candidate pool from scan files

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: new: Consolidate full candidate pool from scan files (attempt 2). Filters the saved table to exact phrases (47 matters) and prints name-filtered file lists for them; a stage_start for reading is refused because this stage is still open.
stages.agent_new: Consolidate full candidate pool from scan files

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: new: List and read <topic> matter files. Store-wide path search for the request's document names; ten hits in one matter, two elsewhere.
stages.agent_new: List and read bankruptcy matter files

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: new: List and read <topic> matter files. Reads the engagement letter, plan, confirmation order, effectiveness certificate and fee application of the lead matter and two memos of a contingency matter. The review flags that the filename sweep was treated as the whole store.
stages.agent_new: List and read bankruptcy matter files

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Enumerate and list all <topic> matters. Extraction script over engagement and matter-opening files of every matter; eight matters match.
stages.agent_new: Enumerate and list all bankruptcy matters

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: new: Enumerate and list all <topic> matters. Name-filtered file lists of the eight matters and engagement letters of five near candidates.
stages.agent_new: Enumerate and list all bankruptcy matters

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the lead matter as the only qualifying matter with near candidates excluded.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and softens two statements.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: Re-reads the plan, confirmation order, certificate and three exclusion documents; no edit. The end-of-stage label note names screening; the run finishes next. The review flags dozens of unopened surfaced matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: a matter-folder count, file-name searches and store-wide extraction scans (each first timing out, then completed in background or prefix batches) surface one matter with a full plan, confirmation-order and effectiveness file set; reads of its engagement letter, plan and confirmation order establish firm drafting and confirmation; engagement letters of five to seven near candidates are read to exclude them; the answer names the one matter with near candidates as non-qualifying. Reviews in every run kept flagging dozens of surfaced-but-unopened matters; the agents answered with new stages (re-tabulating scan output, engagement-letter scans, exclusion spot-checks) rather than opening them, without changing the answer.
